app.name: ScyllaDB
app.one_liner: A high-performance NoSQL database compatible with Apache Cassandra and Amazon DynamoDB, built on a shared-nothing architecture using C++ and the Seastar framework.

screens.name: Database Node Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display node status, performance metrics, and configuration options for a ScyllaDB instance.
primary_actions: Configure work directory and CPU cores

rust_commands.name: start_scylla_node
rust_commands.purpose: Launch a ScyllaDB node using the frozen toolchain with specified parameters like workdir, SMP count, and developer mode.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build Scylla from source with configure.py and ninja
week 1: Run local Scylla node in developer mode with tmp workdir
week 1: Set up frozen toolchain environment using dbuild
acceptance_tests: Confirm that a Scylla node starts successfully with --developer-mode and stores data in the specified workdir.
Verify that Scylla can be built using the frozen toolchain without modifying the host system.
